title: Artist analytics
description: Listen stats, listeners, supporters, and artist revenue.

blocks.subtitle: Overview
blocks.content: The **Analytics** section helps you understand listener interest in your music, track audience support, and see revenue from album sales and subscriptions. All metrics are available in the artist dashboard (**Dashboard → Analytics**).

blocks.subtitle: Choosing a period
content: You can view stats for three periods: **Last 7 days**, **Last 30 days**, and **Last 90 days**.
The selected period applies to KPI cards, the chart, popular tracks, and revenue.

blocks.subtitle: Key metrics
content: **Listeners** — unique listeners in the selected period. Each person is counted once, regardless of how many times they played your music.
**Plays** — listens that reached the qualified listen threshold. Pressing play alone does not always count.
**Regular listeners** — listeners who returned to your music on at least three different calendar days in the last 30 days.
**In collections** — users who added you to their collection.

blocks.subtitle: Listeners chart
blocks.content: The **Unique listeners by day** chart shows daily unique listeners. It helps you spot trends and days with the most activity.

blocks.subtitle: Popular tracks
blocks.content: This block lists your most played tracks in the selected period. Ranking is based on qualified plays.

blocks.subtitle: Supporters
content: This list shows users who added you to their collection and have an active Premium subscription that unlocks your content.
If someone added you to their collection without an active subscription, they count toward **In collections** but do not appear in the supporters list.

blocks.subtitle: Revenue
content: This block shows your revenue for the selected period split into two sources:
**Album sales** — confirmed paid purchases of your albums.
**Subscriber support** — your share of Premium subscription payments from users who included you in their collection.
The total is the sum of both sources.
Amounts are gross totals before payment provider fees.
Subscription revenue is shared among artists in the subscriber’s collection.
Single-album purchases and Premium subscriptions are separate income sources.

blocks.subtitle: When data is still empty
blocks.content: If you are new to the platform, some metrics may stay at zero for a while. That is normal — stats appear as listeners play your music, add you to collections, and make purchases.
